entries.title: Ezra 10:1
segments: ¶Now while Ezra was praying, and while he was confessing, weeping, and bowing down before the house of God, a very large assembly of men, women, and children gathered to him from Israel; for the people wept very bitterly.

entries.title: Ezra 10:2
segments: And Shechaniah the son of Jehiel, [one] of the sons of Elam, spoke up and said to Ezra, "We have trespassed against our God, and have taken pagan wives from the peoples of the land; yet now there is hope in Israel in spite of this.

entries.title: Ezra 10:3
segments: "Now therefore, let us make a covenant with our God to put away all these wives and those who have been born to them, according to the advice of my master and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the law.

entries.title: Ezra 10:4
segments: "Arise, for [this] matter [is] your [responsibility]. We also [are] with you. Be of good courage, and do [it]."

entries.title: Ezra 10:5
segments: Then Ezra arose, and made the leaders of the priests, the Levites, and all Israel swear an oath that they would do according to this word. So they swore an oath.

entries.title: Ezra 10:6
segments: ¶Then Ezra rose up from before the house of God, and went into the chamber of Jehohanan the son of Eliashib; and [when] he came there, he ate no bread and drank no water, for he mourned because of the guilt of those from the captivity.

entries.title: Ezra 10:7
segments: And they issued a proclamation throughout Judah and Jerusalem to all the descendants of the captivity, that they must gather at Jerusalem,

entries.title: Ezra 10:8
segments: and that whoever would not come within three days, according to the instructions of the leaders and elders, all his property would be confiscated, and he himself would be separated from the assembly of those from the captivity.

entries.title: Ezra 10:9
segments: So all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered at Jerusalem within three days. It [was] the ninth month, on the twentieth of the month; and all the people sat in the open square of the house of God, trembling because of [this] matter and because of heavy rain.

entries.title: Ezra 10:10
segments: Then Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, "You have transgressed and have taken pagan wives, adding to the guilt of Israel.

entries.title: Ezra 10:11
segments: "Now therefore, make confession to the LORD God of your fathers, and do His will; separate yourselves from the peoples of the land, and from the pagan wives."

entries.title: Ezra 10:12
segments: Then all the assembly answered and said with a loud voice, "Yes! As you have said, so we must do.

entries.title: Ezra 10:13
segments: "But [there are] many people; [it is] the season for heavy rain, and we are not able to stand outside. Nor [is this] the work of one or two days, for [there are]  many of us who have transgressed in this matter.

entries.title: Ezra 10:14
segments: "Please, let the leaders of our entire assembly stand; and let all those in our cities who have taken pagan wives come at appointed times, together with the elders and judges of their cities, until the fierce wrath of our God is turned away from us in this matter."

entries.title: Ezra 10:15
segments: ¶Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahaziah the son of Tikvah opposed this, and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite gave them support.

entries.title: Ezra 10:16
segments: Then the descendants of the captivity did so. And Ezra the priest, [with] certain heads of the fathers' [households], were set apart by the fathers' [households], each of them by name; and they sat down on the first day of the tenth month to examine the matter.

entries.title: Ezra 10:17
segments: By the first day of the first month they finished [questioning] all the men who had taken pagan wives.

entries.title: Ezra 10:18
segments: And among the sons of the priests who had taken pagan wives [the following] were found of the sons of Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.

entries.title: Ezra 10:19
segments: And they gave their promise that they would put away their wives; and [being] guilty, [they presented] a ram of the flock as their trespass offering.

entries.title: Ezra 10:20
segments: Also of the sons of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah;

entries.title: Ezra 10:21
segments: of the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah;

entries.title: Ezra 10:22
segments: of the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

entries.title: Ezra 10:23
segments: Also of the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (the same [is] Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

entries.title: Ezra 10:24
segments: Also of the singers: Eliashib; and of the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.

entries.title: Ezra 10:25
segments: And others of Israel: of the sons of Parosh: Ramiah, Jeziah, Malchiah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah;

entries.title: Ezra 10:26
segments: of the sons of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Eliah;

entries.title: Ezra 10:27
segments: of the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza;

entries.title: Ezra 10:28
segments: of the sons of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, [and] Athlai;

entries.title: Ezra 10:29
segments: of the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, [and] Ramoth;

entries.title: Ezra 10:30
segments: of the sons of Pahath-Moab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh;

entries.title: Ezra 10:31
segments: [of] the sons of Harim: Eliezer, Ishijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

entries.title: Ezra 10:32
segments: Benjamin, Malluch, [and] Shemariah;

entries.title: Ezra 10:33
segments: of the sons of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, [and] Shimei;

entries.title: Ezra 10:34
segments: of the sons of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel,

entries.title: Ezra 10:35
segments: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluh,

entries.title: Ezra 10:36
segments: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

entries.title: Ezra 10:37
segments: Mattaniah, Mattenai, Jaasai,

entries.title: Ezra 10:38
segments: Bani, Binnui, Shimei,

entries.title: Ezra 10:39
segments: Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,

entries.title: Ezra 10:40
segments: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

entries.title: Ezra 10:41
segments: Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,

entries.title: Ezra 10:42
segments: Shallum, Amariah, [and] Joseph;

entries.title: Ezra 10:43
segments: of the sons of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, [and] Benaiah.

entries.title: Ezra 10:44
segments: All these had taken pagan wives, and [some] of them had wives [by whom] they had children.
